question: Siang, Tirap and Kameng are rivers found in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Arunachal Pradesh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Siang, Tirap and Kameng** are rivers found in the state of **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• The major river of the Arunachal Pradesh is the **Brahmaputra and all the rivers are its tributaries.**
 
• Kameng river formerly known as** Bhareli river and Jia Bhoreli in Assam**.
